archiveTitle: The Royal Purchases of One Lady of the Elven Court
notice: 16 individually identified original ChatGPT-generated Daysha illustrations are published; supplied third-party dress references, annotation previews, earlier rejected crown revisions and other unaudited historic art remain excluded.

garments.title: Blooming Meadow Sapphire-and-Gold Gown
garments.notes: Initial generated character reference in a flowing white, lavender, gold and sapphire floral gown.

garments.title: Ice-Blue Floral Court Gown
garments.notes: Distinct ice-blue floral, embroidered court gown. Later family scenes share a blue floral visual motif, but a physical garment match remains unverified.

garments.title: Roseblush Floral Ombré Gown
garments.notes: White pleated crossover bodice and straps, soft blush-to-coral layered tulle skirt, floral pink appliqués cascading from the waist. Seen on the mannequin during a chocolate delivery and then fitted on Daysha by the resident elven master seamstress. The two scenes depict one physical gown; purchase date and paid price are not verified.

garments.title: Pearlescent Manaweave Floral Gown
garments.notes: Second distinct gown of the same atelier visit as the Roseblush gown. A new mana-infused pearlescent fabric, shimmering icy blue, lavender, silver and delicate iridescent white floral motifs; Daysha displays it with an ornate blue-violet crystal crown without dangling adornments. The shop master is delighted to introduce the fabric to the Queen. Exact date and price paid remain unverified.

sources.title: Pearlescent Manaweave Gown — Crystal-Crowned Atelier Reveal
sources.provenance: Original ChatGPT-generated image of Queen Daysha trying the elven boutique's new pearlescent mana-infused fabric; final approved crown revision with uniformly violet-blue crystals and no dangling crown ornaments. Third-party fabric reference and annotated previews excluded.

sceneSequences.title: The jewel delivery misunderstanding
sceneSequences.description: Daysha pursues a palace servant carrying jewels, Estelle joins the chase, and the delivery is revealed to be for the Queen Mother.

sceneSequences.title: Pastries and the royal daycare
sceneSequences.description: The family shares tiny pastries in the courtyard; Estelle visits the noble children's royal daycare. Two separate images of the same tea occasion are not separate gown purchases.

sceneSequences.title: Estelle's council-chamber ambush
sceneSequences.description: Princess Estelle throws a magical glitter-filled water balloon from the rafters at King Rome during a council gathering. The balloon has burst against his head; her throwing hand is empty as the court laughs. This final continuity-corrected illustration supersedes the earlier version with a balloon still in hand.

sceneSequences.title: Cats, magical cleanup and courtyard stroll
sceneSequences.description: Rome recovers from the glitter prank in the playroom with two Maine Coons; Daysha performs the cleaning spell, then the family walks towards the courtyard.

sceneSequences.title: Chocolates for the seamstresses and the Roseblush fitting
sceneSequences.description: Daysha arrives at the all-elven royal boutique bearing chocolates for the hardworking staff. She discovers a newly completed white-to-pink floral gown on the mannequin, eagerly tries it on, and the newly resident silver-haired master seamstress adjusts its waist while the other elves watch. These are consecutive scenes of the same gown, not separate gown purchases.

sceneSequences.title: The new pearlescent manaweave — second gown of the boutique day
sceneSequences.description: After the chocolates and Roseblush fitting, Daysha tries the boutique's second gown of the day: a radiant, mana-infused pearlescent fabric newly introduced by the elven master seamstress. The shop master proudly presents her invention. Crown revisions are one finalized scene, not additional dress purchases.
